name: Faces
lead: A block's faces: one picture, or `all`, `side`, `top`, `bottom`, `front`, `back`, or a face by name.

fields.name: all
fields.signature: faces.all: TextureRef ?, side: TextureRef ?, top: TextureRef ?, bottom: TextureRef ?
fields.description: `all` is one picture for all six faces, `side` for the four sides (`all` if left out), `top` and `bottom` the ends.

fields.name: front
fields.description: `front` is the side a facing block faces and `back` the other; a face left out is `side`.

fields.name: down
fields.signature: faces.down: TextureRef ?, up: TextureRef ?, north: TextureRef ?, south: TextureRef ?, west: TextureRef ?, east: TextureRef ?
fields.description: One face by its name; a face left out is `side`.
